description: Phase 6bu gate — NULLIF(x, y) scalar builtin. Returns NULL if x is NULL or x equals y under same-tier equality (no numeric-vs-text coercion); else returns x. Rides OP_SCALAR2 as SCALAR2_NULLIF. No new opcode, no new invariant. Cross-corroboration origin: random/expr full-corpus gate on 2026-04-20 surfaced NULLIF as the single largest COMPILE_UNKNOWN_FUNCTION bucket on both C and Rust. Mainline-SQLite semantics verified via sqlite3 :memory: on 2026-04-20 for every literal case below.

cases.name: nullif-null-first
cases.description: x is NULL -> NULL (NULL-in on first arg short-circuits to NULL).

cases.name: nullif-null-second
cases.description: y is NULL, x is non-NULL -> x (comparison with NULL is not-equal under our rule; x is returned).

cases.name: nullif-both-null
cases.description: x is NULL -> NULL (first-arg short-circuit; matches mainline NULLIF(NULL, NULL)=NULL).

cases.name: nullif-numeric-text-no-coercion
cases.description: Numeric vs text: NOT equal under our same-tier rule (mirrors mainline SQLite on literal pairs). NULLIF(5, '5') = 5 — verified on mainline sqlite3 :memory:.

cases.name: nullif-int-real-equal
cases.description: Same-tier numeric with cross-type value equality: 1 == 1.0 under SortValueEq -> NULL. Verified on mainline.

cases.name: nullif-in-expression
cases.description: NULLIF embedded in an aggregate expression: NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) + 1 over a 3-row table. COUNT(*)=3, NULLIF(3,0)=3, 3+1=4.

cases.name: nullif-in-projection
cases.description: NULLIF in a row-at-a-time projection: rows where a=0 become NULL, others pass through.

program.sql: SELECT NULLIF(a, 0) FROM t ORDER BY a;

cases.name: nullif-arg-count-mismatch-one
cases.description: NULLIF with only one argument -> COMPILE_SCALAR_ARG_COUNT_MISMATCH { function: NULLIF, expected: 2, got: 1 }.

cases.name: nullif-star-rejected
cases.description: NULLIF with STAR as an argument -> COMPILE_SCALAR_ARG_MISMATCH { reason: star-not-allowed }.
